label: Cream / Ivory
description: A cream or ivory lining introduces warmth and a sense of historic luxury to the jacket interior, evoking the soft interiors of Edwardian dress coats and vintage English suiting from the golden age of bespoke tailoring. It is particularly effective in dark navy, charcoal, or black outer fabrics where the pale interior creates a luminous flash of contrast when the jacket opens, and it suits formal occasions where the wearer wants understated opulence rather than bold colour. Cream Bemberg or silk has a slightly warmer, more aged feeling than pure white and flatters virtually all skin tones when glimpsed at the lining edge.
